goals: Verify the successful insertion of a new entity using the MyBatis mapper
Verify the pagination functionality when querying entities using PageHelper
activities: Create a TestModel instance and set its attributes including age, creation date, update date, and username
Insert the TestModel entity into the database using the mapper
Create and insert 100 TestModel entities in a loop to populate the database for pagination testing
Query a paginated list of TestModel entities with an ID greater than 0 using the service
Assert that the page size of the queried result is greater than or equal to 5
Assert that the number of elements in the queried page is exactly 20
